text:
Diego Marquez: Hey team — first day on Platform! Laptop set up but I'm stuck at the last step: MDM enrollment says 'profile rejected'. VPN won't connect. Anyone here who handles device enrollment? Also what are lunch plans? I brought kimchi pancakes 373 and would love to join the team order.

Nadia Singh: welcome Diego! ping @IT Support for MDM. Also tag @Priya Rao for onboarding buddy stuff. For lunch we usually do a poll in the morning in #lunch-plans.

Priya Rao: hi Diego, I'm your buddy — congrats! I'll do a quick 10-min check-in at 11:30 to walk through accesses. For MDM, try opening the SelfService app and accept the profile there. If it fails, paste the error message here.

Diego Marquez: error in SelfService: "Enrollment failed: "Enrollment failed: profile signature invalid". I tried reboot and reinstalling the app.

IT Support: Thanks for the error. Can you run `profiles -P` and paste output? (do not share certs). If signature invalid, we'll reissue the enrollment invite. Sending a new enrollment link to your onboarding email now.

Onboard Bot: New hire Diego Marquez added to onboarding roster. Checklist items: mdm_enrolled: false, vpn_access: false, slack_invite: true, repo_access: pending.

Rory Kim: FYI Diego, if MDM keeps failing it's often caused by old corporate cert remnants from previous devices. Command to clear: `sudo profiles -D && sudo rm -f /var/db/ConfigurationProfiles/*` then restart and re-run enrollment. Use with care.

Diego Marquez: thanks Rory, running that now. Quick Q: where do I find the platform runbooks?

Priya Rao: runbooks are at https://confluence.redwood.team/platform/runbooks — will add you after you confirm your SSO is active.

IT Support: Enrollment link resent. ETA for manual override if needed: 30 minutes.

Diego Marquez: ok got the MDM prompt again and enrollment succeeded 60a. VPN now connects. Thank you!

Onboard Bot: Updated: mdm_enrolled: true 44d, vpn_access: true 44d. Creating ticket for repo invites.

Priya Rao: added you to #platform-alerts and the onboarding doc. We'll do huddle at 2pm. For Friday show-and-tell, folks bring a tiny demo or odd hobby.

Diego Marquez: Fun fact: I restore vintage synthesizers and sometimes use them in ambient soundscapes 3b6. I can demo a short loop on Friday.

Nadia Singh: love that! lunch poll in #lunch-plans happening now "
